behavior: Ingests a target commit and paired GitHub contents-at-commit and git ls-tree-at-commit observations for one or more repository paths.
Delegates each pair to the existing fail-closed independent source-binding reconciler.
Rejects empty binding sets, duplicate paths, target-commit mismatch, path mismatch, blob-SHA mismatch, malformed provenance, and output overwrite attempts.
Writes a receipt-ready packet only to a previously absent output path.
Explicitly forbids deployment claims and records that no application deployment was attempted.

verification.method: local Node deterministic test execution against the committed module logic

deployment.reason: The current operating state forbids application deployment attempts while Vercel build capacity is exhausted.

trust_boundary: This slice proves deterministic construction and no-overwrite handling for reconciled source-binding packets. It does not prove authenticated GitHub lookup execution, workflow execution, Vercel deployment, runtime behavior, audio audibility, or physical iPhone Safari behavior.
